title: Dual Debiasing: Remove Stereotypes and Keep Factual Gender for Fair Language Modeling and Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the probability of models generating specific gendered pronouns ('he', 'she', 'them') given occupational prompts, measuring coreference resolution accuracy differences between masculine/feminine and pro-/anti-stereotypical entities using the WinoBias dataset, and assessing the accuracy of generating gender-inflected profession words in machine translation using the WinoMT and BUG datasets.
